title: artemisia borealis subsp. purshii
intro: Artemisia borealis subsp. purshii, commonly known as Western mugwort or Rocky Mountain mugwort, is a subspecies of the Artemisia borealis plant. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Western mugwort include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can aid in the treatment of digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Western mugwort include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, pain relief, and antimicrobial activity.
